يعتقلوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَقِلُوا (yaʕtaqilū) /jaʕ.ta.qi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# يُعْتَقَلُوا (yuʕtaqalū) /juʕ.ta.qa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
